description: A plugin listed in the marketplace. Beyond the marketplace-specific fields (source, category, tags, strict, relevance, headers, headersHelper) an entry may carry any field of the plugin manifest schema. Unknown fields are validator warnings (errors under --strict).

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor tooling; ignored at load time (inherited from the plugin manifest schema).

name.description: Plugin identifier (kebab-case recommended); users see it in /plugin install <name>@<marketplace>. Must be unique in the marketplace. A name that passes as one of Anthropic's own is an error in `claude plugin validate` (case-insensitive, a run of separators counts as one): a claude-, anthropic-, anthropics- or cc-plugin- prefix; exactly claude, anthropic, anthropics, claude-code or claude-mods; or official beside claude or anthropic. A whole word elsewhere (mcp-for-claude) is only a warning and is not enforced here.

source.description: Where to fetch the plugin from: a relative path string, a bare directory name (with metadata.pluginRoot), or one of the source objects github, url, git-subdir, npm, archive, command (discriminated by the 'source' key). There is no pip, zip or generic 'git' plugin source in the docs; the CLI rejects them.

displayName.description: Human-readable name for UI surfaces; may contain spaces and any casing; not used for namespacing or lookup.

version.description: Plugin version. If set here or in plugin.json the plugin is pinned to this string and users only receive updates when it changes (plugin.json wins if both are set; ignored for command sources). Semver recommended, not enforced.

author.description: Person or organization. Docs list name (required), email and url. The CLI accepts unknown keys here without a warning.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (for example MIT, Apache-2.0).

keywords.description: Tags for plugin discovery and categorization.

metadata.description: Free-form object for your own fields (entitlement, catalog data); Claude Code does not read it. A non-object value is ignored with a validator warning.

strict.description: Whether plugin.json is the authority for component definitions (default true: entry supplements plugin.json and both merge; false: the entry is the entire definition and a plugin.json that also declares components is a conflict).

relevance.description: Signals telling Claude Code when to suggest this plugin. Only takes effect for marketplaces an administrator allowlists in managed settings (pluginSuggestionMarketplaces). Unknown keys are validator warnings.

defaultEnabled.description: Whether the plugin is enabled after install (default true). false installs it disabled; takes precedence over plugin.json.

dependencies.description: Other plugins this plugin requires, optionally with semver constraints. A manifest may consist of only name plus dependencies to act as a bundle.

skills.description: Custom skill directories containing <name>/SKILL.md (adds to the default skills/ scan; with a marketplace-root source the listed paths are the complete set). Each path starts with './' (or is '.').

commands.description: Custom flat .md skill files or directories (replaces default commands/). The CLI (and the SchemaStore baseline) also accept an object form mapping command names to {source|content, description, argumentHint, model, allowedTools}; the docs only describe string|array.

workflows.description: Custom workflow script files or directories (replaces default workflows/).

hooks.description: Hook configuration: path to a .json file, inline event map, or a list mixing both.

mcpServers.description: MCP server definitions: path to a .json config file, an inline map of server name to config, or a list mixing both.

lspServers.description: LSP server definitions: path to a .json file, inline map of server name to config, or a list mixing both.

outputStyles.description: Custom output style files or directories (replaces default output-styles/).

userConfig.description: User-configurable values prompted when the plugin is enabled. Keys must be valid identifiers.

channels.description: Channel declarations for message injection (Telegram, Slack, Discord style).

experimental.description: Experimental component declarations whose schema may change between releases.

themes.description: DEPRECATED top-level spelling of experimental.themes: still loads, but validation warns and a future release will require experimental.*.

monitors.description: DEPRECATED top-level spelling of experimental.monitors: still loads, but validation warns and a future release will require experimental.*.

settings.description: Settings to merge into user settings while the plugin is enabled (docs: only the agent and subagentStatusLine keys are supported).
settings.x-note: In the SchemaStore baseline and accepted by CLI 2.1.281; the docs describe this only as a settings.json file at the plugin root, not a manifest key.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent when downloading this entry's archive; overrides same-named marketplace headers (v2.1.238+). Only meaningful for archive sources.

headersHelper.description: Command that prints the archive-download headers as one JSON object, for short-lived credentials. Printable ASCII, max 500 characters, no runs of four or more spaces. The entry must set strict: false (v2.1.238+). Only meaningful for archive sources.

types.description: Path (starting ./) to the plugin's TypeScript type contract, ending in .d.ts; must stay inside the plugin directory.
types.x-note: Accepted by CLI 2.1.281 ("types must name a TypeScript declaration file ending in '.d.ts'"); not in the current plugins-reference component tables.

binaries.description: Map of basename to {sha256}: platform binaries fetched into bin/ at install time. `claude plugin validate` does not type-check this field at the marketplace-entry level (a bare string passes unchanged, oracle-verified); the object shape below is the documented/baseline intent, not an enforced constraint.
binaries.x-note: Accepted by CLI 2.1.281 and present in the SchemaStore baseline; not in the current docs.

allOf.description: headersHelper requires strict: false (error in the CLI).
headers/headersHelper only apply to archive sources (validator warning otherwise).
